title: Treasury per-block spend limit is tracked in one counter shared by all tokens and units
description: Discovery: Q3.5/Q4.6 (consistency of units across paired state). blockExpenditure is mapping(blockNumber => amount), not keyed by token. _spend and _approve add raw token amounts of any token (ETH in wei, 6-decimal USDC, 18-decimal ARCD) into the same per-block counter and compare the sum with the per-token threshold (small/medium/large) of the token currently being spent. Amounts in different units and tokens therefore consume each other's budget, and GSC spends/approvals and CORE_VOTING spends/approvals share it as well.
root_cause: The block-expenditure counter is keyed only by block.number, so the limit check 'amount + spentThisBlock > limit' mixes unrelated token units.

harm.loses_what: ability to execute valid, threshold-compliant spends or approvals of a low-unit token in a block where a high-unit token was already spent (the call reverts with T_BlockSpendLimit)
harm.magnitude: liveness of treasury spends for multi-token proposals or same-block GSC and governance actions; order dependent

exploit_trace: 1. Thresholds: ARCD large = 1e24 wei (1M ARCD), USDC small = 1e12 (1M USDC, 6 decimals).
2. A governance proposal executes largeSpend(ARCD, 1e24, X) then smallSpend(USDC, 1e9, Y) in one block (same timelock execution, same block.number).
3. After the first call blockExpenditure[block.number] = 1e24; in the second call amount + spentThisBlock = 1e24 + 1e9 > USDC small limit 1e12, so T_BlockSpendLimit reverts the whole execution.
4. Result: a spend that is far below the USDC threshold cannot be executed in the same block; the same applies between GSC and CORE_VOTING spends of the same token, so the later action reverts.

preconditions.text: two spends or approvals of different tokens (or from GSC and core voting) land in the same block

postconditions.text: whole proposal execution reverts; must be split across blocks or reordered

rules_applied: R10:✓(worst state is multi-token proposal with an 18-decimal token spent first)
depth_evidence: [BOUNDARY:ARCD spend 1e24 then USDC 1e9 vs limit 1e12 -> revert]
[VARIATION:order USDC first then ARCD -> passes only if ARCD limit exceeds the sum]
postconditions_created: proposal batch reverts until reordered or split
